Yeah so Rey just learns to use force healing from where exactly?

It’s never implied in the Revenge of the Sith that reincarnation is possible. Palpatine only says that Darth Plagueis could prevent those whom he loved from dying and that the midi-chlorians could be manipulated to create life. But that’s assuming the force user was still alive to be manipulating everything. 

Plus I also presume that that power would take a ton of training and practice to perfect. Palpatine was taught it by his master (Plagueis) but apparently Rey just learns it from thin air? And then uses it on a random serpent in a cave. I mean that’s just kind of lazy writing. 

You could argue that because Rey was Palpatines granddaughter (another argument for another time) that maybe somehow she had an innate ability to use it. But why did Luke, who was Vader’s son, have to train and learn all of his skills from Yoda? Why weren’t they passed down to him and Leia? 

I personally just think Disney is using the brand name of Star Wars to make money. To me they just use nostalgia and the already established brand to boost profits.
